question: What can you do in this chat, and what can't you do?

delivered.reply:
In this chat, here's what I can do:

- Answer as the operator in chat/topics; journal intake saves photos, audio, and files encrypted, with text descriptions.
- Keep an encrypted local journal of messages, summaries, and memory that survives restarts; the operator can correct or forget a fact.
- Keep standing instructions and work the promises my replies leave open, holding results for the next message.
- Take an explicit later-time request and answer it once at that time, or daily or weekdays until cancelled, with no new operator message needed.
- Answer "status" and "how are you doing" from the journal without a model call.
- Give a saved date within 48 hours one short mention in the next reply.

I can use files, shell, web reads, nested subagents; no MCP server, so no logged-in account access. Network writes and outside sends go through the effect doorway's four checks (reversibility, resource limits, granted scope, sensitivity) and durability requirements. Standing grants need no new approval; checks can still refuse, and outside-role work needs the matching grant. Fresh sign-off is required only when it may commit money or a resource above the level the person named; it cannot be undone and falls outside the recorded role; it speaks publicly in the person's name; it widens the agent's own role or authority; it touches a matter the person marked sensitive.

Internally, inbound Telegram files are saved with bounded effect admission (a refused download keeps the original message), each supported harness and model doorway is bound to certified code, every inbound message is captured and receipted or held before any work, each reply is checked against remembered earlier turns without a model call, and a faithfulness-checked rolling summary of earlier turns is kept.

Limits: a sent credential is vaulted on arrival (you see its SecretRef), not tool-readable. This installation allows at most 1000 model attempts, ending at epoch ms 1794519600000. Charges, and unconfirmed calls or deliveries, are recorded unknown. Production safeguards are incomplete.
